title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: 《傲慢与偏见》是英国著名女作家简·奥斯汀（Jane Austen）于 1813 年出版的世情小说代表作。故事围绕贝内特一家五姐妹的婚事展开，主线为二女儿伊丽莎白·贝内特（Elizabeth Bennet）与高傲富有的达西先生（Mr. Darcy）之间的情感纠葛。伊丽莎白因达西的傲慢态度对其抱有深厚偏见，而达西也因伊丽莎白出身中产家庭而心生顾虑。随着一系列误会与事件的解开，两人逐渐看清了自己的内心与对方的真情。本书机智幽默，刻画人物入木三分，是理解 19 世纪英国社会风情与学习高级风雅英语对话的典范。

chapters.title: Chapter 1: A Truth Universally Acknowledged
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 1 章：举世公认的真理

paragraphs.en: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个举世公认的真理，一个拥有巨额财产的单身汉，必定需要一位妻子。

paragraphs.en: However little known the feelings or views of such a man may be on his first entering a neighbourhood, this truth is so well fixed in the minds of the surrounding families, that he is considered the rightful property of some one or other of their daughters.
paragraphs.zh: 无论这样一个男人在初次进入一个街区时，人们对他的感受或看法知之甚少，这一真理在周围家庭的心目中是如此根深蒂固，以至于他被视为他们某个女儿的合法国产。

paragraphs.en: "My dear Mr. Bennet," said his lady to him one day, "have you heard that Netherfield Park is let at last?"
paragraphs.zh: “我亲爱的班奈特先生，”他的夫人有一天对他说，“你听说内瑟菲尔德庄园终于租出去了吗？”

paragraphs.en: Mr. Bennet replied that he had not.
paragraphs.zh: 班奈特先生回答说他没有。

paragraphs.en: "But it is," returned she; "for Mrs. Long has just been here, and she told me all about it."
paragraphs.zh: “但确实租出去了，”她回答说；“因为朗太太刚刚来过这里，她把这一切都告诉我了。”

paragraphs.en: Mr. Bennet made no answer.
paragraphs.zh: 班奈特先生没有回答。

paragraphs.en: "Do you not want to know who has taken it?" cried his wife impatiently.
paragraphs.zh: “难道你不想知道是谁租了吗？”他的妻子耐心地大喊。

paragraphs.en: "YOU want to tell me, and I have no objection to hearing it."
paragraphs.zh: “你想告诉我，我不反对听。”

paragraphs.en: This was invitation enough.
paragraphs.zh: 这邀请就足够了。

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Mr. Bennet Visits Netherfield
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 2 章：班奈特先生拜访内瑟菲尔德

paragraphs.en: Mr. Bennet was among the earliest of those who waited on Mr. Bingley. He had always intended to visit him, though to the last always assuring his wife that he should not go; and till the evening after the visit was paid she had no knowledge of it.
paragraphs.zh: 班奈特先生是早拜访宾利先生的人之一。他一直打算去拜访他，尽管到最后一直向他的妻子保证他不去；直到拜访后的那天晚上，她才知道这件事。

paragraphs.en: It was then disclosed in the following manner. Observing his second daughter engaged in trimming a hat, he suddenly addressed her with:
paragraphs.zh: 然后是以以下方式揭露的。看到他的二女儿正忙着修剪一顶帽子，他突然对她说：

paragraphs.en: "I hope Mr. Bingley will like it, Lizzy."
paragraphs.zh: “我希望宾利先生会喜欢它，丽兹。”

paragraphs.en: "We are not in a way to know what Mr. Bingley likes," said her mother resentfully, "since we are not to visit."
paragraphs.zh: “我们无法知道宾利先生喜欢什么，”她的母亲怨恨地说，“因为我们不去拜访。”

paragraphs.en: "But you forget, mama," said Elizabeth, "that we shall meet him at the assemblies, and that Mrs. Long has promised to introduce him."
paragraphs.zh: “但你忘了，妈妈，”伊丽莎白说，“我们会在舞会上遇到他，朗太太已经答应把他介绍给我们了。”

paragraphs.en: "I do not believe Mrs. Long will do any such thing. She has two nieces of her own. She is a selfish, hypocritical woman, and I have no opinion of her."
paragraphs.zh: “我不相信朗太太会做这样的事。她自己有两个侄女。她是一个自私、虚伪的女人，我对她没有任何好感。”

paragraphs.en: "No more have I," said Mr. Bennet; "and I am glad to find that you do not depend on her serving you."
paragraphs.zh: “我也一样，”班奈特先生说；“我很高兴发现你不指望她为你服务。”

chapters.title: Chapter 3: The Assembly Ball at Meryton
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 3 章：麦里屯的舞会交锋

paragraphs.en: Not all that Mrs. Bennet, however, with the assistance of her five daughters, could ask on the subject, was sufficient to draw from her husband any satisfactory description of Mr. Bingley. They attacked him in various ways—with barefaced questions, ingenious suppositions, and distant surmises; but he eluded the skill of them all.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，班奈特太太在她的五个女儿的帮助下，在这个问题上所能问的一切，都不足以从她的丈夫那里得出对宾利先生的任何满意的描述。她们以各种方式攻击他——用赤裸裸的问题、巧妙的假想和遥远的猜想；但他避开了她们所有人的技巧。

paragraphs.en: They were at last obliged to accept the second-hand intelligence of their neighbour, Lady Lucas. Her report was highly favourable. Sir William had been delighted with him. He was quite young, wonderfully handsome, extremely agreeable, and, to crown the whole, he meant to be at the next assembly with a large party.
paragraphs.zh: 她们最后不得不接受她们的邻居卢卡斯太太的二手情报。她的报告非常有利。威廉爵士对他感到非常高兴。他相当年轻，非常英俊，极其讨人喜欢，最重要的是，他打算带一大群人参加下一次舞会。

paragraphs.en: Nothing could be more delightful! To be fond of dancing was a certain step towards falling in love; and very lively hopes of Mr. Bingley's heart were entertained.
paragraphs.zh: 没有什么比这更令人愉快的了！喜欢跳舞是坠入爱河的确定一步；人们对宾利先生的心抱有非常活泼的希望。

paragraphs.en: Mr. Bingley was good-looking and gentlemanlike; he had a pleasant countenance, and easy, unaffected manners.
paragraphs.zh: 宾利先生长相英俊，有绅士风度；他有一副令人愉快的面容，以及轻松、自然举止。

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Jane and Elizabeth Discuss Mr. Bingley
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 4 章：简与伊丽莎白的闺中密语

paragraphs.en: When Jane and Elizabeth were alone, the former, who had been cautious in her praise of Mr. Bingley before, expressed to her sister how very much she admired him.
paragraphs.zh: 当简和伊丽莎白单独在一起时，前者之前在赞扬宾利先生时一直很谨慎，她向她的妹妹表达了她是多么钦佩他。

paragraphs.en: "He is just what a young man ought to be," said she, "sensible, good-humoured, lively; and I never saw such happy manners!—so much ease, with such perfect good breeding!"
paragraphs.zh: “他正是一个年轻男子应该有的样子，”她说，“通情达理，幽默活泼；我从未见过这么幸福的举止！——如此轻松，带有如此完美的良好教养！”

paragraphs.en: "He is also handsome," replied Elizabeth, "which a young man ought likewise to be, if he possibly can. His character is thereby complete."
paragraphs.zh: “他也英俊，”伊丽莎白回答，“如果可能的话，年轻男子也应该英俊。他的性格从而完整了。”

paragraphs.en: "I was very much flattered by his asking me to dance a second time. I did not expect such a compliment."
paragraphs.zh: “他第二次邀请我跳舞，我感到非常荣幸。我没有期待这样的夸奖。”

paragraphs.en: "Did not you? I did for you. But that is one great difference between us. Compliments always take you by surprise, and me never. What could be more natural than his asking you again? He could not help seeing that you were about five times as pretty as any other woman in the room."
paragraphs.zh: “你没有吗？我为你期待了。但那是我们之间的一个巨大区别。夸奖总是让你感到意外，而我从来不会。他再次邀请你还有什么比这更自然的呢？他忍不住看到你比房间里的任何其他女人都要漂亮大约五倍。”

chapters.title: Chapter 5: The Lucas Family and Charlotte’s Wisdom
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 5 章：卢卡斯一家与夏洛特的智慧

paragraphs.en: At a short distance from Longbourn resided the Lucas family, with whom the Bennets were particularly intimate. Sir William Lucas had been formerly in trade in Meryton, where he had made a tolerable fortune, and risen to the honour of knighthood during his mayoralty.
paragraphs.zh: 在距离朗伯恩不远的地方住着卢卡斯一家，班奈特一家与他们特别亲密。威廉·卢卡斯爵士以前在麦里屯做生意，在那里赚了一笔相当可观的财产，并在他担任市长期间上升到了爵位的荣誉。

paragraphs.en: Lady Lucas was a very good kind of woman, not too clever to be a valuable neighbour to Mrs. Bennet. They had several children. The eldest of them, a sensible, intelligent young woman, about twenty-seven, was Elizabeth's intimate friend.
paragraphs.zh: 卢卡斯太太是一个非常好的人，不太聪明，不至于成为班奈特太太的有价值的邻居。他们有几个孩子。她们中最大的一个，一个通情达理、聪明的年轻女子，大约二十七岁，是伊丽莎白的亲密朋友。

paragraphs.en: That Charlotte Lucas should me with Elizabeth to talk over the ball was absolutely necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 夏洛特·卢卡斯和伊丽莎白一起谈论舞会是绝对必要的。

paragraphs.en: "You began the evening well, Charlotte," said Mrs. Bennet with civil self-command to Miss Lucas. "You were Mr. Bingley's first choice."
paragraphs.zh: “你今晚开局很好，夏洛特，”班奈特太太带着礼貌的自制对卢卡斯小姐说。“你是宾利先生的第一选择。”

paragraphs.en: "Yes; but he seemed to like his second better."
paragraphs.zh: “是的；但他似乎更喜欢他的第二个选择。”
